notes: Unlike English 'eat', 먹다 is also commonly used in casual speech for drinks (커피를 먹다) and is the standard verb for taking medicine (약을 먹다).
When speaking to or about someone of higher status, use the honorific verb 드시다 or 잡수시다 instead.
